title: Strangers in a Strange Land

beats.what: Cold-open recap montage plays over S01 highlights establishing stakes before new arrivals
Tabitha falls through collapsing basement floor; Jim calls for help as storm destroys the radio tower
A bus full of new arrivals appears parked outside the diner during the storm chaos
Victor leads Tabitha through the underground tunnels where the monsters sleep, guided by the boy in white
Boyd wakes in a pit, hears a man calling from above and begins to climb toward a stranger
Jade searches Victor's room, finds old Polaroid showing Victor as a boy holding the journal
Jim sends Julie for help while he remains at the collapsed floor above Tabitha

character_beats.beat: Wants to maintain order and protect Colony House; tells Kenny the town needs someone to step up and names him acting sheriff, but her control is slipping the moment the bus arrives
Wants to understand the place (was digging to trace the wires); ends up utterly dependent on Victor underground, inverting her role as the parent who investigates
Wants to lead people home; instead surfaces alone in a pit, helpless and disoriented, shouting into darkness
Wants an answer to the repeating symbol; rifles Victor's room, finds the Polaroid linking Victor to the journal's original owner

key_lines.speaker: Donna
key_lines.line: There are things you need to know about where you are.
key_lines.why: First line of authority spoken to newcomers; Donna frames herself as the gatekeeper of truth

key_lines.speaker: Tabitha
key_lines.why: Reaction to seeing the tunnels under the town where the monsters sleep; first confirmation of the underground world

key_lines.line: This is where the monsters live. This is where they sleep.
key_lines.why: Victor names the threat directly, grounding the underground as the creatures' resting place

key_lines.line: I can help you if you help me.
key_lines.why: The stranger in the pit offers mutual aid; sets up the episode's central exchange of survival

key_lines.line: You never know where you'll end up.
key_lines.why: The Faraway Tree rule stated plainly; explains the show's portal logic in a single line

key_lines.line: Boyd picked one hell of a time to go on safari.
key_lines.why: Donna's black-humor line names Boyd's absence as the structural problem this season opens with

open_loops: Who is the man calling from above the pit Boyd is trapped in, and what does he want in exchange for help?
The boy in white told Victor to wait in the tunnels for Tabitha: who is the boy in white and how does he know what will happen?
The repeating symbol appears in an old journal and in Jade's visions: what does it mean and who drew it first?
The radio made contact just before the tower was destroyed: who answered and what did they want?
Tabitha was digging to trace the wires: what are the wires connected to and why does the place have unexplained electricity?

payoffs.what: Victor's knowledge of the underground tunnels, hinted across S01, is confirmed as direct experience when he guides Tabitha through them

contradiction.wants: to hold the community together under clear rules while Boyd is absent
contradiction.does: shoots out the bus tires to stop newcomers leaving, which panics everyone and fractures the trust she is trying to maintain

tone_notes: Runtime 46.1 min, 861 cues, 93.7 words/min. Two hard silences: 452-569s (nearly 2 minutes, covering the bus passengers sitting in paralysed darkness during the monster hours) and 2293-2340s (end-of-night stillness before dawn rescue). Density spikes above 160 words/min at minutes 2-3 (recap chaos), 17 (storm hits tower), 33 (Jade's panic in Victor's room), 36 (diner confrontation), 43 (tunnels escape). Victor's name chanted 36 times in dialogue, more than any character including the leads, marking his centrality to both plot threads this hour.
